report:
Finger, right middle finger, excision

Received in formalin is a piece of tissue labelled right middle finger, measuring 0.8 x 0.6 x 0.5 cm. All embedded in 1 block.

(1) Lesion, all embedded.

Sections show a focal collection of mucin in the dermis, with surrounding fibrous stroma and no epithelial lining. The features are those of a digital mucous (myxoid) cyst. There is no evidence of malignancy.

FINGER, right middle finger, excision - DIGITAL MUCOUS CYST
